modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate OCI Monitoring alarms (metric queries, notification destinations, severity) - maps blue-team detection coverage per compartment
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate OCI Streaming streams and stream pools (data-plane messages endpoints, Kafka settings, encryption keys) - exfil/interception surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate OCI Queue queues (data-plane messages endpoints, retention/visibility, DLQ, encryption keys) - read/inject message surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate OCI Cache (Redis) clusters (endpoints/FQDNs, node sizing, subnet, cluster mode). Caches frequently hold session tokens, credentials, and PII - a high-value data-exfiltration surface.
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate OpenSearch clusters (OpenSearch/Dashboard FQDNs and private IPs, security mode, subnet/VCN, node/storage sizing). Clusters aggregate logs and application data and often have weak internal auth.
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate WAF web application firewalls and firewall policies (backend/LB bindings, actions, access-control and rate-limiting rules). Policy rules reveal bypass conditions of value to blue and red teams.
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Aggregate all network identifiers (IPs, CIDRs, URLs, FQDNs, subnet/VCN refs) from every saved resource into one inventory
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Analytics Cloud instances - exposes analytics service URLs, network endpoint exposure (public vs private), and KMS key usage
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Big Data Service (BDS) instances - managed Hadoop/Spark clusters run jobs as the cluster identity, so a compromised cluster is code-exec-as-cluster-identity
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Data Catalog catalogs, private endpoints, and metastores - maps where sensitive data lives plus the network endpoints and object-storage table locations backing it
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Data Safe target databases, security/user assessments, and sensitive data models - reveals where sensitive data lives, which databases are monitored, and risky DB users
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Management Agents and install keys - install keys are a lateral-movement primitive that let an attacker enroll new agents to run commands on hosts
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Vulnerability Scanning scan targets and detected vulnerabilities - reveals exploitable CVEs and exactly which hosts/container images are affected
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate AI Language projects, custom models, and inference endpoints - custom models expose training-data lineage and endpoints are hijackable inference surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Database Management resources (named credentials, managed databases, cloud DB systems, private endpoints) - named credentials are stored DB credential references and DB systems expose the database attack surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Delegate Access Control resources - reveals which Oracle/3rd-party operators can break-glass into your resources and any pending/active delegated access requests
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Fusion Applications environments and families - exposes public SaaS ERP/HCM/SCM endpoints, DNS prefixes, and break-glass/lockbox access controls
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Generative AI projects, endpoints, dedicated AI clusters, and API keys - dedicated endpoints/clusters are hijackable inference surface and API keys expose the credential surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Digital Assistant (ODA) instances - exposes web-app/connector endpoints and identity-domain bindings that front conversational AI channels
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Visual Builder instances - low-code app-hosting VMs exposing instance URLs and public/private network endpoints
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate + persist the tenancy's SUBSCRIBED regions (list_region_subscriptions) - drives multi-region enum_all --find-regions/--regions
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Privileged API Access Control resources - reveals which sensitive API operations are gated, who can invoke them, and pending privilege-elevation requests ripe for abuse
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate auto-scaling configurations - reveal instance-pool launch templates that embed cloud-init/user-data secrets and enable stealthy compute-spawn persistence
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Cloud Bridge inventories, asset-sources, and agents - maps discovered on-prem/other-cloud assets and the discovery agents that can pivot into them
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Cloud Migrations migrations - exposes migration projects and their replication schedules, revealing source/target workload inventory and migration configuration
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Database Migration connections and migrations - exposes source/target DB credential references (Vault/KMS OCIDs) and migration topology
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Database Tools connections and private endpoints - connections hold DB usernames, connection strings, and Vault secret references (user_password_secret_id) usable to pivot into backend databases
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate DB Multicloud identity connectors - cross-cloud AWS/GCP/Azure IAM+KMS trust links that can be pivoted to other clouds
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Generative AI Agents (agents, endpoints, knowledge bases, tools) - reveals sensitive RAG corpora, hijackable inference endpoints, and function-calling exec surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Governance Rules and their tenancy attachments - reveals org-wide policy/quota/tag rules pushed down onto child tenancies (privileged control structure worth mapping)
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Health Checks HTTP/ping monitors - reveals the exact public and internal endpoints, ports, paths, and headers the org probes (attack-surface recon)
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Lockbox managed-access break-glass resources - reveals which sensitive resources have Oracle/partner break-glass access, the approval templates gating it, and max access durations
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate VMware Solution SDDCs, datastores, and clusters - exposes self-managed vCenter/NSX/ESXi endpoints (FQDNs, software versions) that are a large lateral-movement surface
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Operator Access Control resources - reveals Oracle break-glass policies, where they're applied, and active/pending operator sessions into Exadata/DBaaS
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate Tenant Manager organizations, domains, and cross-tenancy invitations - reveals linked tenancies and pending join invites for cross-tenancy trust-establishment footholds
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate WAAS (legacy WAF/edge) policies, certificates, custom protection rules and HTTP redirects - policy origins reveal backend server addresses that can be hit directly to bypass the WAF
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Enumerate WebLogic Management domains and managed instances - WebLogic middleware exposes admin consoles historically prone to RCE
modules.author: OCInferno

modules.info_blurb: Push OCI OpenGraph custom node color/image styling to BloodHound (standalone; re-style without regenerating the graph).
modules.author: OCInferno
